legend: The Curse of Tutankhamun (Valley of the Kings, Egypt, 1922-1923)
lines: Egypt, 1922. Howard Carter opens the sealed tomb of young King Tutankhamun.
Gold glitters in the torchlight, untouched for three thousand years.
Then people start whispering about a curse.
On the day of the discovery, legend says, a cobra swallowed Carter's pet canary.
Months later, Lord Carnarvon, who funded the dig, fell ill in Cairo.
He died in April 1923, and legend says every light in the city went dark.
Newspapers screamed about the curse of the pharaohs.
Scientists point out that most of the team lived for many more years.
Still, the legend never died. Would you open that tomb?
title: King Tut's Curse: The Canary, the Cobra and the Night Cairo Went Dark #shorts
description:
After the tomb of Tutankhamun was opened in 1922, newspapers blamed a pharaoh's curse for every misfortune. What does the legend say, and what do the facts say?
